clauses.why: Inspecting the full effective policy (offsets, retry budget, spacing) is a viewing capability reminders work without.
A per-invoice activity view is added reporting; reminders send correctly without it.
Access control for the activity view arises only because the spec added that view.
A deployment-wide rollback stop is an operational capability beyond setting up reminders.
Permission on the policy view arises only from the added policy-inspection feature.
Categorised hold-reason display is added operator tooling; held invoices simply don't send without it.
Ingesting provider evidence to resolve uncertain attempts is added reconciliation machinery.
Deduplicating outcome reports arises only from the added outcome-report ingestion and activity view.
Associating late outcome reports arises only from the added report ingestion.
Showing accepted activity after interruption concerns the added activity display, not sending.
Precedence rules for the added deployment-wide stop.
Rollback/redeploy preservation scenarios are introduced by the spec's rollback procedure, not the request.
A twelve-state activity taxonomy is added reporting detail.
Milestone schedule display in activity is added reporting.
Per-attempt audit facts exposure is added reporting beyond reminders.
States that provider limits exist but gives no figures; nothing actionable beyond C-17.
Operations inspection of host and provider limits is added tooling.
A 15-minute uncertain-display bound serves the added activity and health views.
An operations health dashboard is an added capability.
Authority for added deployment-wide health and stop controls.
Data-minimisation rules for the added operations health view.
Bounce handling arises only if post-acceptance delivery reports are ingested, which the request doesn't need.
Rollback of the release is a scenario the spec introduced, not something reminders require.
A 24-hour inter-milestone spacing rule is an added restriction beyond the chosen schedule.
Exposing earliest retry time is added activity reporting.
Distinguishing failure kinds in activity is added reporting.
Displaying post-acceptance bounces is added reporting.
'Last effective change' wins is true of any toggle and leaves overlapping order undefined.
Verifying outcome-report association arises only from added report ingestion.
Conflict handling for added outcome-evidence ingestion.
Defines a ready count for the added operations backlog metric.
Preserving superseded attempts in activity is added reporting.
Stop persistence across rollback concerns the added deployment-wide stop.
Rollback-time attempt identification serves the added rollback and activity features.
A reconciliation reference for operations is added investigation tooling.
Visible empty-evaluation heartbeat is added health-monitoring.
Availability of the added activity view after deletion.
Independent inspection of history versus eligibility is added reporting.
Retaining displayed acceptance concerns the added activity view.
